summary.text: John Conyers III is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 3, having won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary with 24.4% of the vote in an 11-candidate field.
His professional experience includes working as a hedge fund manager, a grassroots organizer and an author with Amistad/HarperCollins.

paragraphs.text: Conyers is the son of former U.S. Rep. John Conyers Jr. (D).

He ran as a write-in candidate in the 2018 general election for Michigan's 13th Congressional District, finished fourth in the 2022 Democratic primary for that seat with 8.6% of the vote (6,778 votes), and was listed among withdrawn or disqualified candidates in the 2024 Democratic primary.
